classwise_policy_search.warning: Full-valid policy search is optimistic. Patient cross-fit estimates this policy selection procedure within the same validation cohort; it is not a new independent test set or proof of deployment gain. Pooled cross-fit AUC may additionally reflect score-scale differences across fold-specific policies. Within-fold patient-heldout deltas are also provided using positive-negative pair weighting per class.
